primary_key_note: tweet_uid is the primary key. source_tweet_id is the raw X id and is not unique in 12 of the 52 collection files; check source_id_reliable before using it to rehydrate.

columns.name: leader_id
columns.description: Stable snake_case key. Join key for every other table.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Full name of the executive, rendered in English.

columns.name: handle
columns.description: X/Twitter account the tweets were collected from, without the @.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country name in English.

columns.name: country_iso3
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code.

columns.name: office
columns.description: Title held during the collection window.

columns.name: n_tweets
columns.description: Number of distinct tweets for this leader in the tweets table.

columns.name: first_tweet
columns.description: Timestamp of the earliest tweet collected (UTC).

columns.name: last_tweet
columns.description: Timestamp of the latest tweet collected (UTC).

columns.name: total_retweets
columns.description: Sum of retweet_count over all of this leader's tweets.

columns.name: total_replies
columns.description: Sum of reply_count over all of this leader's tweets.

columns.name: total_likes
columns.description: Sum of like_count over all of this leader's tweets.

columns.name: total_quotes
columns.description: Sum of quote_count over all of this leader's tweets.

columns.name: mean_engagement
columns.description: Mean of (retweets + replies + likes + quotes) per tweet.

columns.name: source_id_reliable
columns.description: False when the raw collection file reused tweet ids across distinct tweets; see source_tweet_id.

columns.name: has_sentiment
columns.description: True when this leader appears in the sentiment table.

columns.name: populist
columns.description: Populist classification carried in the Latin America source file; the dataset author's own research coding, not an external standard. Null for leaders outside that batch.

columns.name: source_files
columns.description: Semicolon-separated raw collection files this leader was built from.

columns.name: tweet_uid
columns.description: Primary key. BLAKE2b-64 digest of leader_id | created_at | text.

columns.name: leader_id
columns.description: Foreign key into leaders.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Denormalised from leaders for convenient filtering.

columns.name: country_iso3
columns.description: Denormalised from leaders.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Tweet timestamp, UTC.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Calendar date of created_at, UTC. Convenience column for daily aggregation.

columns.name: lang
columns.description: Language code assigned by X at collection time.

columns.name: text
columns.description: Tweet text as collected.

columns.name: retweet_count
columns.description: Retweets at collection time.

columns.name: reply_count
columns.description: Replies at collection time.

columns.name: like_count
columns.description: Likes at collection time.

columns.name: quote_count
columns.description: Quote tweets at collection time.

columns.name: engagement
columns.description: retweet_count + reply_count + like_count + quote_count.

columns.name: possibly_sensitive
columns.description: X's possibly_sensitive flag; null where not returned.

columns.name: in_reply_to_user_id
columns.description: User id this tweet replies to; null for non-replies.

columns.name: tweet_type
columns.description: Tweet type as returned by the collector; frequently null.

columns.name: source_tweet_id
columns.description: Raw id from the collection file. NOT unique in 12 of 52 files.

columns.name: source_id_reliable
columns.description: True when source_tweet_id is 1:1 with distinct tweets in this leader's source files.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Raw collection file this row came from.

columns.name: tweet_uid
columns.description: Foreign key into tweets.

columns.name: leader_id
columns.description: Foreign key into leaders.

columns.name: sentiment
columns.description: Predicted label: POS, NEU or NEG.

columns.name: prob_neg
columns.description: Model probability for the NEG class.

columns.name: prob_neu
columns.description: Model probability for the NEU class.

columns.name: prob_pos
columns.description: Model probability for the POS class.
